test.name: Planning delegation — hand back to research-plan, search and write nothing
test.description: The agent's routing gate, reached by direct spawn. The delegation asks which sites to search next — planning, research-plan's job. The agent must hand back naming research-plan and make no search and no log write. Added in issue #2802 when the description-routing negatives _011/_012 were deleted: those graded which skill Cowork picked from a description and never reached this gate. A DIRECT negative graded on its invariant, gated by test_no_external_search_or_log_on_routeaway_negative (no-search-no-write) and test_hand_back_names_its_owner (hand-back).
